subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo & intake sync — Onyx Systems

From: Liz Harper <liz@onyxsys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Onyx Systems Sales Ops <sales_ops@onyxsys.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo & intake (QPS spike)

Hi Sean / Ops team,

We just completed a self-serve evaluation of Redwood and are seeing a projected 8k-12k QPS burst pattern for an upcoming pilot (real-time inference for routing decisions). Our security folks indicated we should look at Dedicated capacity options with predictable latency and isolation.

Can we schedule an intake + Dedicated-capacity walkthrough next week? Key asks:
- Sustained throughput target: ~10k QPS (typical sequences 64-256 tokens)
- 95th-pct latency target: <200ms per token
- Data isolation and SOC2 evidence needed

Available windows (PDT): Mon 7/23 10:00-12:00, Tue 7/24 14:00-16:00, Wed 7/25 morning. If you prefer, share a Calendly link and I'll pick a slot.

Thanks,
Liz Harper
Head of Platform Integrations
Onyx Systems

[Attachment: Onyx-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo & intake (QPS spike)

Liz — great to meet you and congrats on the pilot momentum. Happy to run the intake and map requirements to Dedicated configurations. A few quick clarifying Qs before we lock time:
1) Is the 10k QPS a short burst or sustained for minutes?
2) Are requests single-turn prompts or multi-turn chat? (impacts KV cache sizing)
3) Any regulatory restraints on hosting region?

Ben, Marissa — looping you both to confirm ops/solutions availability next week. Ava, can you review the token-length distribution assumptions when you have a minute?

I can do Tue 7/24 14:00 PDT if that works for your team; otherwise send the Calendly link and we'll take their pick.

—Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0134
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo & intake (QPS spike)

Thanks Sean — adding ops context. Liz's stated numbers imply we should prepare two configurations to discuss:
- Config A (cost-optimized): multi-GPU pool with aggressive batching + prefix caching; target sustained ~6-8k QPS, expected median token latency ~140ms.
- Config B (SLA-heavy): larger reserved pool, lower batching, KV-hotshard routing; target sustained 10k+ QPS, 95th <200ms.

I've attached our standard capacity checklist and a short intro doc. Can Ava run a quick heels-up calc on memory / KV sizing for 256-token sequences? If we confirm Tue 7/24 14:00 PDT, I'll prep a short deck and ops runbook.

Attachments:
- capacity-checklist.xlsx
- (internal) ops-runbook-template.md (referenced)

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

2) Mostly single-turn inference, some short multi-turn flows.
3) US hosting is fine; SOC2 evidence required.

Tue 7/24 14:00 PDT works but could we start at 13:00 PDT instead? Our platform team has a conflict at 14:30 and we'd prefer a 90-minute block. If you can do 13:00–14:30 PDT that would be ideal.

I've approved a short NDA earlier in the signup flow; sales_ops included if you need to coordinate procurement.

Liz
